confirmed_findings.finding: Root README and several 00_META maps describe the pre-reorganization topology and are stale relative to the current backbone.
AGENTS and YARP are first-class backbone modules in implemented candidate architectures but are absent from YOS-MODULE-REGISTRY v1.0 and the older repo map.
ART and CRT are routing submodules of AGENTS/04_ROUTING, not standalone backbone modules.
File-count claims conflict: root README says 915, pre-reorg inventory says 940; a fresh authoritative census is required.
KAP source registries contain substantial prior metadata assimilation, but the current YOS monorepo itself has not yet been fully registered and semantically classified as a source instance.
The KAP adapter census is useful but contains environment-specific status from Manus in July 2026 and must not be treated as timeless capability truth.
The absolute JSON-first rule conflicts with canonical Markdown ADRs and specifications; source authority must be defined by object type, not extension alone.
ADR-005 and policy-manifest fixed agent roles are bootstrap configuration partially superseded by orchestrator-agnostic AGENTS/ART/CRT routing.
ADR-004 remains useful history but its seven-folder monorepo topology is superseded by the implemented canonical layers.
The Manus skill deployment registry contains 35 skills while its README documents only seven; the README is a stale partial view.
yos-manus-client, manus-enhancer and yos-cockpit are overlapping generations of the YOS Shell and require file-level lineage reconciliation before development resumes.
Provider-neutral workflows and Manus-specific execution instructions are mixed inside the legacy skill corpus.
Canonical automation/interface destinations are not proof of completed migration; substantive implementations remain in legacy paths.
Empty n8n and playbook roots mean not recovered in those paths, not proof that the workflows never existed.
Canonical knowledge-domain directories are empty scaffolds; substantive Y-WORLD content remains in legacy or external sources.
The root contains both 03_AUTOMATIONS and 05_AUTOMATION, requiring explicit lineage and authority reconciliation.
The repository has a CANON root whose relationship to Governance, Knowledge Domains and source-of-truth policy is not yet reconciled.
Several canonical app/product directories are placeholders, while substantive implementations remain in legacy roots.
Global logging directories are unevenly populated; module-local ledgers and global logs need a crosswalk.
